title: ER visit: ankle injury
text: Emergency department note. Patient rolled right ankle playing basketball. X-ray right ankle: nondisplaced hairline fracture of the distal fibula. Plan: posterior splint, crutches, Demoprofen 400 mg as needed, orthopedics in one week.

title: Orthopedics follow-up
text: Fracture healing as expected. Transition to walking boot for six weeks, then physical therapy.

title: Discharge summary: appendectomy
text: Admitted with right lower quadrant pain. CT abdomen and pelvis: acute appendicitis without abscess. Laparoscopic appendectomy performed. Discharged on Fakeazole 500 mg twice daily for seven days.

title: Annual physical
text: Blood pressure 148/92 on two readings. Hemoglobin A1c 6.0 (prediabetes range). Start Examplol 10 mg daily. ECG normal sinus rhythm.

title: Hospital statement
text: Statement of account. Appendectomy admission 4/9/2021 to 4/11/2021. Total charges 18,450.00.
